content.title: How to Start Selling Digital Products with Crypto Payments

content.text: What This Actually Is and Why It Matters: Music online

Selling music online is not just about putting your tracks on a website; it’s about establishing a solid infrastructure that enables you to process transactions effectively and efficiently. Current platforms impose heavy fees and restrictions, making it hard for creators to thrive. For instance, Gumroad charges 10% on every sale, while using NOWPayments only incurs a 0.5% fee. This difference means retaining more of your earnings. Understanding how to navigate this landscape is critical for any digital creator looking to monetize their work sustainably.
How the Architecture Works Under the Hood

The infrastructure for selling music online involves several key components working together. By leveraging tools like Cloudflare Pages for hosting and NOWPayments for cryptocurrency transactions, you can create a system that is both efficient and cost-effective. The architecture uses automated delivery via Google Apps Script or Cloudflare Workers to manage product delivery seamlessly. This means once a customer pays in Bitcoin, they instantly receive their music files without any manual intervention, enhancing customer satisfaction and streamlining your operations.
Who This Is Built For and Why

This infrastructure is built for independent musicians and digital creators in regions with limited access to mainstream payment processors. It caters specifically to those who produce digital products like music tracks, courses, and templates, allowing them to bypass the limitations imposed by conventional platforms. Creators in countries like Nigeria, Zimbabwe, and Venezuela are especially poised to benefit from this setup. It empowers them to take control of their earnings and operate a sustainable business without the constraints of traditional payment systems.
Gumroad’s 10% fee means losing nearly $1,000 on 100 sales compared to NOWPayments’ 0.5%.
The Components That Make It Work Together

At the core of this solution are several components: Cloudflare Pages for hosting, Google Apps Script or Cloudflare Workers for backend logic, and NOWPayments for cryptocurrency processing. When a customer makes a purchase, the transaction is processed on-chain using a network like BSC, Solana, or TRON, which ensures low fees and rapid confirmation. The integration of these tools allows for an efficient workflow from order placement to delivery, giving creators the ability to manage their digital storefront independently and effectively.
How to Use This Knowledge to Deploy Today

To start selling your music without relying on platforms like PayPal or Stripe, first, choose your hosting solution, either Cloudflare Pages or GitHub Pages. Next, set up your backend logic using Google Apps Script or Cloudflare Workers to handle order processing. Integrate NOWPayments for automated crypto transactions. Lastly, ensure your product files are stored in Google Drive or Cloudflare R2 for instant delivery. For a comprehensive guide on deploying this system, consider the Complete Builder Kit ($197), which includes all the resources you need to get started.
How do I sell an ebook online without PayPal or Stripe?

To sell an ebook online without PayPal or Stripe, you can utilize alternative payment processors like NOWPayments that support cryptocurrency transactions. This method allows you to bypass traditional platforms altogether while still providing a seamless purchasing experience for your customers. By leveraging free hosting and backend options, you can set up your digital storefront quickly and efficiently.
You control your entire sales process, from product hosting to payment processing.
Related: How Creators Like You Are Building Sovereign Stores

If you're looking to explore further ways to sell digital downloads without platform fees, consider the Complete Builder Kit ($197). It includes all necessary blueprints and templates to build your digital commerce stack, which offers complete ownership of your sales infrastructure. For more information, visit https://coremerch.github.io/products.html.
Your Deployment Checklist

Prepare your product files in delivery-ready format — PDF for ebooks, ZIP archives for multi-file products, exported files for Notion templates, OTF and TTF archives for font families. Set your prices in USD and let NOWPayments handle the crypto equivalent calculation automatically at transaction time. Deploy your stack and configure the product list with file paths, USD prices, and delivery settings. Configure your storefront with product pages and checkout flow. Test the checkout on both desktop and mobile — confirm QR codes generate correctly and live price feeds display accurately. Complete a real mainnet test transaction and confirm the delivery email arrives with a working download link. Check your order database and confirm the test transaction appears with all correct fields.
Frequently Asked Questions
How do I sell music online without PayPal or Stripe?

You can sell music online by using cryptocurrency payment processors like NOWPayments. This allows you to accept Bitcoin and other cryptocurrencies directly, avoiding the limitations of traditional payment platforms.
What is the best way to sell digital downloads without platform fees?

The best way is to build your own digital storefront using free tools like Cloudflare Pages for hosting and NOWPayments for payment processing. This setup minimizes fees, increases your profit margins, and allows for full control over your sales.
Can I sell templates and fonts without using Gumroad or Payhip?

Yes, you can sell templates and fonts by setting up your own website and using NOWPayments to handle transactions. This approach keeps you independent of platform fees and gives you complete ownership of your sales process.
What tools do I need to sell digital products effectively?

Essential tools include a hosting service like Cloudflare Pages, a backend processing solution like Google Apps Script, and a payment processor like NOWPayments. These tools work together to create a seamless selling experience.
How do I ensure my customers receive their purchases instantly?

By using automated delivery systems through Google Apps Script or Cloudflare Workers, you can ensure that customers receive their digital products immediately after payment confirmation. This enhances customer satisfaction and improves repeat sales.
